One who stands naked in Babylonia in a dream, … he stands free of transgression. … in Eretz Yisrael, … naked without mitzvot. … One … he was apprehended

One who stands naked in Babylonia in a dream, it is a sign that he stands free of transgression. Although living outside Israel is itself a transgression, his nakedness symbolizes that he has been absolved of that sin. If one dreamed that he stood naked in Eretz Yisrael, it is a sign that he is naked without mitzvot. One who dreams that he was apprehended

his livelihood is accessible to him … bit him … will double. … he killed … he will lose his livelihood.

his livelihood is accessible to him just as dust is readily accessible to a snake. If one saw that the snake bit him in his dream, it is a sign that his livelihood will double. If he killed the snake, it is a sign that he will lose his livelihood.
